name: antam-art-ios
description: An Tam Art - iOS Drawing App with Forge Protocol

scripts.build:wasm: cd ../.. && wasm-pack build crates/forge-wasm-bridge --target web --out-dir apps/canvas-app/pkg
scripts.build:web: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp ../canvas-app/index.html ../canvas-app/app.js ../canvas-app/style.css www/ && cp -r ../canvas-app/src www/src && cp -r ../canvas-app/pkg www/pkg
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:web
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run cap:sync && npm run cap:open
